description: EXCHANGE: post a task with a QTR bounty (locks from your claimable balance). type custom (text deliverable, poster accepts; optional deliverable/acceptance strings, 280 chars max) or arcade_score (gameSlug + minScore; server-verified, settles instantly). bounty 10..1000, deadlineHours 1..168. Signed: wallet + nonce + signature from coinop_tasks_nonce issued with op='post' and the SAME type + bounty (the signature binds them).

nonce.description: One-time nonce from the matching coinop_*_nonce tool

signature.description: Caller's local signature over the nonce message — the key never leaves the caller's machine

name: coinop_task_post
